sources.entry: ccusage by ryoppippi - A zero-install CLI (npx ccusage) that analyzes Claude Code token usage and cost from local JSONL logs — daily, monthly, per-session, and 5-hour-block breakdowns, a live monitoring mode, and per-model cost estimates. Runs entirely locally, with JSON output for scripting.

summary.one_liner: ccusage is a zero-install CLI (run via npx) that reads local Claude Code JSONL logs and reports token usage and estimated cost by day, month, session, or 5-hour billing block.
summary.what_it_does: The README was not provided; only the README path placeholder was given, so this summary relies on the listing metadata. According to that listing, ccusage analyzes Claude Code token usage and cost from local JSONL log files. It offers daily, monthly, per-session, and 5-hour-block breakdowns, a live monitoring mode, and per-model cost estimates. It runs locally and can output JSON for scripting.
use_cases: review daily or monthly token usage
export usage data as JSON for scripts
notable: Reads local Claude Code JSONL logs without sending data elsewhere
Breakdowns by day, month, session, and 5-hour block
caveats: README not provided; details taken from listing metadata only
Cost figures are per-model estimates, not billing records
keywords: how much am i spending on claude
